findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a pytest repo uses `python_files = test_*.py *_spec.py`, has no `always_test`, and a source change selects two of twelve `test_*.py` files. `related()` in src/forge/fasttest.py:408-411 does not count the `_spec.py` files, but pytest collects them under that configuration. The selection hook at src/forge/fasttest.py:530-532 does not filter them when there are no always tests. The calculation here therefore chooses one group for 2/12 while the command also runs every `_spec.py` test, risking the original timeout. [Pytest supports configuring these discovery patterns.](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/example/pythoncollection.html) The full-command fallback also remains reachable with one group: with no `fast_test`, the test-only shortcut at line 105 runs before the mixed-command fallback in src/forge/fasttest.py:313-320 is checked.
findings.title: Keep all groups when the PR command runs a wider test set

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a repo runs `pytest tests -q`, with 20 live tests and 80 fixture-repository tests under `tests/fixtures` excluded by pytest's `norecursedirs = fixtures`. A central change selects all 20 live tests. This prefix check still includes the 80 excluded files in the denominator, so it classifies the entire runnable suite as 20% and assigns one group. src/forge/fasttest.py:44-67 reads pytest's `addopts` but does not account for `norecursedirs`; [pytest excludes matching directories from collection](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/example/pythoncollection.html). The original timeout can therefore recur.
findings.title: Count only test files belonging to the configured suite

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - Forge's own forge.toml:7-8 uses `uv run --frozen --python 3.11 forge test --pytest {base}` as `fast_test`. This exact-string guard rejects that picker even after the generated job installs Forge, so a narrow source change still runs all six groups. The later argument check at line 123 also rejects the `-o` and timeout options in Forge's configured pytest command. tests/test_selected_tests_choose_groups.py:25-32 replaces those settings with an unwrapped picker and simpler pytest command, so it passes without covering the shipped configuration.

why: In a repo with several test groups, a change of 5 or fewer code files runs one test group even when it touches a central file and selects most of the suite; a client's story part (5 files including a central module) ran one group, hit the 60-minute limit and was cancelled on every run
